g.text: Review event results and demo readiness
Validate BIB uniqueness and linked records
Show known DNF without finish values
Present matched photos or no-photo state
Business process expressed as a UML activity with responsibility lanes;
not a BPMN 2.0 conformance claim. FR-01-FR-18, NFR-09.
Timing and photo collection are simulated. No registration or payment workflow.
Organizer preparation precedes runner use; no organizer approval per recap.
